description: Header file defining the Blit11 class for texture copy and blitting operations in Direct3D 11 rendering context, including shader management, resource initialization, and copy functions.

classes.name: Blit11
classes.description: A utility class for performing texture copying, swizzling, and depth/stencil operations in Direct3D 11.

classes.name: Shader
classes.description: Represents a shader with associated resources and state.

classes.name: ShaderSupport
classes.description: Holds support resources for a shader, including input layout and shader stages.

methods.name: swizzleTexture
methods.description: Performs texture swizzling based on the specified swizzle state.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies and optionally downscales a texture from source to destination.

methods.name: copyStencil
methods.description: Copies stencil buffer data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDepth
methods.description: Copies depth buffer data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDepthStencil
methods.description: Copies depth and stencil buffer data.

methods.name: resolveDepth
methods.description: Resolves depth data into a texture.

methods.name: resolveStencil
methods.description: Resolves stencil data into a texture.

methods.name: initResources
methods.description: Initializes GPU resources needed for blitting operations.

methods.name: getShaderSupport
methods.description: Retrieves support resources for a specific shader.

methods.name: getBlitShader
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shader for blitting operations based on formats and parameters.

methods.name: getSwizzleShader
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shader for texture swizzling.
